title: Mailgun Private API key and HTTP webhook signing key: one-property twin (length)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 33-byte body (one extra [a-z0-9] byte at offset 16) vs the 32 every source carries (gitleaks, trufflehog, Nosey Parker, Mailgun's own PHP SDK test key). Twin of "Mailgun Private API key and HTTP webhook signing key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
